title: Activate parts on the Inactive tab opens the same bulk mode with Activate
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], signed in with the Admin role. Admin holds the 'Part Library & Inventory' permissions View, Create & Edit and Delete by default (Settings → Roles & Permissions); Delete is what allows Deactivate parts and Activate parts.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: at [Loc-1], inactive [Part-A] and [Part-B] and active [Part-C], part numbers ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKON-01 to -03 (examples).

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. Create [Part-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL bulk on A" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKON-01 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-A] = the part number you typed.
  3. Create [Part-B]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL bulk on B" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKON-02 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-B] = the part number you typed.
  4. Create [Part-C]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL bulk on C" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKON-03 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-C] = the part number you typed.
  5. Make [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-A] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  6. Make [Part-B] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-B] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  7. Check the setup worked: searched for ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKON, the Inactive tab lists [Part-A] and [Part-B] and the Active tab lists [Part-C].
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the Inactive tab.
  3. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKON in the Search box.
  4. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar (to the left of New Inventory Part).
  5. Click Activate parts.
  6. Click the [Part-A] row.
  7. Click the X at the right end of the bar.
  8. Click the Active tab.
  9. If the Search box is empty, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKON in it.
  10. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  11. Click Deactivate parts.
  12. Click the [Part-C] row.
  13. Look at the colour of the Deactivate button.
  14. Click the X at the right end of the bar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The menu lists "Cycle count", "Activate parts" and "Export".
  • Step 5: The same bulk mode as on the Active tab turns on: a checkbox column appears at the left of the table and the same dark bar appears under the tabs, reading "0 selected", with a blue button "Activate" and an X at the right end.
  • Step 6: The bar reads "1 selected" and the Activate button is enabled (bright blue).
  • Step 7: Bulk mode ends; [Part-A] is still inactive.
  • Step 13: The Deactivate button on the Active tab is the same blue as the Activate button on the Inactive tab.
  • Step 14: Bulk mode ends; nothing changed status.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S3-R1, S3-R2, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.6 (Inactive tab, Activate parts), board 4.3 (Two rows ticked).   • S3-R2: “The bulk bar button reads "Activate", in the same blue as "Deactivate".”
